q: The whole knowledge base is 756 tokens. What does it cost to put it in the prompt of 1,000 questions?
why: 756 tokens times 1,000 questions is 756,000 tokens, which is 0.756 million, so 0.756 dollars at one dollar per million.

q: What does a million tokens cost at a price of 1.0 per million?
why: Cost is tokens divided by a million, times the price per million.
